newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Monday in lacklustre trading before the Eid al-Adha festival from Thursday, brokers at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.

Prices were likely to open unchanged on Tuesday due to a lack of buying interest by spinners, broker Nasim Usman said. In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted at 2,100/2,225 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), K-68 at 2,450/2,475 and MNH-93 at 2,460/2,485.
The broker said prices were likely to remain stable due to a lack of cotton demand from mills and unsold stocks of more than 1.2 million 375-lb bales at ginneries by April 3.
